messages.text:
The landing page for "Codey" (the iPad IDE for kids) will use a **Playful Creative** aesthetic. The design will focus on making coding feel like digital LEGO—tactile, colorful, and approachable—while maintaining a high-quality product feel for parents.

### Design Direction: "Playful Creative"
- **Palette:** Warm white background (`#FFFBF5`) with "Codey Purple" (`#7C3AED`) as the primary brand color. We'll use secondary pops of Mint (`#10B981`) and Sunset Orange (`#F59E0B`) for feature categorization.
- **Typography:** **Plus Jakarta Sans** for its friendly, modern roundness. Headlines will be oversized and bold (up to 72px) to grab attention.
- **Signature Move:** "Tactile Blocks"—UI elements (cards, buttons, screenshots) will have soft, thick borders (2px) and subtle, colored shadows that give them a physical, "pressable" toy-like quality.

### Layout Strategy
- **Hero Section:** A split layout featuring a punchy headline ("Code your own world") on the left and a high-fidelity iPad mockup on the right showing a "drag-and-drop to Python" interface.
- **"The Playground" Feature Grid:** A 3-column grid of "Activity Cards" (Game Maker, Robot Controller, Art Studio) using the tactile block style.
- **Social Proof:** A "Parent & Educator Trusted" marquee with logos and a single, high-impact testimonial from a 10-year-old creator.
- **Final CTA:** A high-contrast section with a massive "Download on App Store" button and a small illustration of the app icon character.

### Specifications
- **Canvas Width:** 1440px (Desktop Web Landing Page)
- **Primary Font:** Plus Jakarta Sans
- **Core Radius:** 24px (Large, friendly corners)

Does this direction work for you? If so, I’ll begin building the `.gui` package.
